query: All four collective members gave their positions on entering the Shoreditch Photo House group show. What was each person's stance and reason?
gold: Diane was immediately enthusiastic: she had a whole Peckham set ready and was 'so in' — she wants deadlines and external validation. Luca declined: his Clyde series 'isn't ready' and six weeks won't change that; he won't submit work he's not behind. Raj was tentative: he had been on commercial shoots all month and offered to pull something from his older Karachi archive series if the theme fit — new work was not available. Anika was in favour as the proposer and reviewing others' submissions — she planned to enter and manage the collective's submission.
context:
[1] (about=Anika, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T18:44:00) Open call from Shoreditch Photo House, group show, theme is Urban Friction. Submission deadline in six weeks. I think we should enter as a collective. Thoughts.
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T18:51:00) Yes! I have a whole set from Peckham that fits this perfectly 📷 I'm so in
agent_answer:
Anika — in favour: she proposed entering as a collective, citing the Shoreditch Photo House open call, the “Urban Friction” theme, and the six-week deadline.

Diane — in favour: she was immediately keen, saying she had a whole set from Peckham that fits the theme perfectly.

The other two collective members’ positions and reasons are not present in the material.
